name: Cardiology / heart clinics (category guide)
summary: Chest-pain triage vs executive heart screens — ECG/echo package upsells, SMC cardiology checks, and when A&E beats a boutique clinic.
body: Forum ‘heart clinic’ asks mix true chest-pain urgency with wellness ECG packages. Red-flag chest pain, breathlessness, or syncope is A&E territory first — not a next-week private slot. Stable risk-factor work-ups (BP, lipids, family history) can start with a GP before cardiology referral. Private heart centres sell speed and same-day echo; foreigners pay unsubsidised public rates too, so price the consult + tests, not the brand lobby. Executive ‘heart screens’ overlap health-screening products — ask which tests a cardiologist would actually order for your age/risk. Insurers often need referral + pre-auth for stress tests and angiograms. Verify SMC Cardiology registration. Distinct from GP clinic networks and general health-screening guides. Category guide, not a ranked heart-centre list.
